Last but not least, be quiet!'s reputation for quality and reliability shines through in every aspect of the Pure Power 12 M. Built with premium components and backed by a five-year warranty, I have complete peace of mind knowing that my system is powered by a PSU that's built to last. In conclusion, if you're in the market for a high-performance, energy-efficient, and whisper-quiet power supply unit, look no further than the Pure Power 12 M 1000W from be quiet!. With its 80 Plus® Gold certification, modular design, and rock-solid reliability, it's the perfect choice for discerning PC enthusiasts who demand nothing but the best.

reviews.title: Hasn't died yet.
reviews.comment: As stated, hasn't died yet. Thats a harsh testament to how PC hardware outlooks are these days. My old Raidmax 850ae gold psu was still going strong since 12.5.2013. That is equal parts glorious and terrifying. I was getting black screens and total system freezes in GTA online, occasionally in other games so I started looking into possibilities. One was failing psu, so I got this one on the BF sale. Now, it didnt fix my issue (issue was steam/nvidia/discord In Game Overlay breaking stuff.) So far my PC runs and is quiet (cpu cooler fan is a tad noisy - obviously not a reflection on this conponent ) The modular cables are nice. Its all black - very nice. It seems like a good value for the cost. I have an RTX2070super so I did not try the PCIe 5 connector.

reviews.title: Great PSU.
reviews.comment: So far so good. Great PSU. Was having issues with my old Corsair ax1200i after it sat in storage for about 6 years. I decided to switch up my build and change cases so I went from a Lian Li 011 mini to a SUP01 and the Cooler Master sfx PSU I was using wouldn't fit so I drug out the old Corsair and it would cause a hard crash when my 7900XTX was under full load. Ordered this to replace it and has been good ever since. PSU is quiet under load and provides plenty of power. Also like the fact that even though the pcie cables are dual 8pin, the design of the PSU provides full wattage to both ends of the single dual 8pin.
